name: NOMNI
description: NOMNI is an issuer-described world currency and unit of account on Bitcoin / Counterparty. The 1 NOMNI Bill is the issuer-designated one-unit bill design for the same NOMNI token. Bill artwork and denomination record: https://crown.holytemples.org/assets/NOMNI/bill-1.json. The linked SHA-256 identifies the exact artwork; individual printed bills require separate funding and redemption verification.
